//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Sub-world: Prontera and Izlude
//===== Description: =========================================
//= Players cannot leave these 39 maps. The portals at the edge
//= are disabled. Any other way out (a Kafra teleport, a boat, a wing, a quest
//= warp, an old save point) brings them back to where they last arrived in
//= this world, or to the start. A save point outside moves to the start.
//= GMs (group 99) travel freely.
//=
//= Loaded with loadevent.txt by: setup-macos.sh start --sub-world prontera
//= Generated by tools/sub_worlds.py: edit the tool, not this file.
//===== Settings read by setup-macos.sh: =====================
//= start_point: prontera,156,191
//============================================================

-	script	SubWorld#prontera	-1,{
OnInit:
	setarray .maps$[0],
		"prontera", "prt_in", "prt_church", "prt_castle", "izlude", "izlude_in",
		"prt_fild00", "prt_fild01", "prt_fild02", "prt_fild03", "prt_fild04", "prt_fild05",
		"prt_fild06", "prt_fild07", "prt_fild08", "prt_fild09", "prt_fild10", "prt_fild11",
		"prt_sewb1", "prt_sewb2", "prt_sewb3", "prt_sewb4", "izlu2dun", "iz_dun00",
		"iz_dun01", "iz_dun02", "iz_dun03", "iz_dun04", "prt_maze01", "prt_maze02",
		"prt_maze03", "prt_monk", "monk_in", "monk_test", "job_sword1", "job_knt",
		"job_prist", "job_cru", "job_monk";
	.start$ = "prontera";
	.start_x = 156;
	.start_y = 191;
	// The portals at the edge of the world.
	disablenpc "mazewarp5137";
	disablenpc "prtca002";
	disablenpc "prtf001";
	disablenpc "prtf007";
	disablenpc "prtf008";
	disablenpc "prtf009";
	disablenpc "prtf010";
	disablenpc "prtf011";
	disablenpc "prtf012";
	disablenpc "prtf013";
	disablenpc "prtf014";
	disablenpc "prtf015";
	disablenpc "prtf016";
	disablenpc "prtf017";
	disablenpc "prtf018";
	disablenpc "prtf019";
	disablenpc "prtf020";
	disablenpc "prtf021";
	disablenpc "prtf022";
	disablenpc "prtf023";
	disablenpc "prtf024";
	disablenpc "prtf025";
	disablenpc "prtf026";
	disablenpc "prtf027";
	disablenpc "prtf028";
	disablenpc "prtf029";
	disablenpc "welcome_arena";
	// Added to this world.
	duplicate "Ascetic#2aco", "prt_fild09", 246, 30, "Ascetic#sw2aco";
	end;

OnPCLoadMapEvent:
	if (getgroupid() >= 99)
		end;
	getmapxy(.@map$, .@x, .@y);
	if (inarray(.maps$[0], .@map$) >= 0) {
		@sub_world_map$ = .@map$;
		@sub_world_x = .@x;
		@sub_world_y = .@y;
		if (inarray(.maps$[0], getsavepoint(0)) < 0)
			savepoint .start$, .start_x, .start_y;
		end;
	}
	dispbottom "The way beyond is closed. You are taken back.";
	if (@sub_world_map$ == "")
		warp .start$, .start_x, .start_y;
	else
		warp @sub_world_map$, @sub_world_x, @sub_world_y;
	end;
}
